chars.MAID: MAID: a young woman wearing a light blue maid tunic dress with a white apron and a pale yellow headscarf.
chars.SON: SON: a young man wearing a fitted burgundy polo shirt, white chinos, a shiny gold watch and white sneakers.
chars.HAJJA: HAJJA: an older kind woman wearing an elegant emerald green caftan with gold trim.
chars.HAJJ: HAJJ: an older man wearing a cream djellaba and a red fez.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside the big modern kitchen of a luxury villa in Casablanca. SON leans in the doorway with a cheeky grin, staring at MAID. MAID holds a plate, looks down at the floor, embarrassed and blushing. Awkward funny tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Luxury villa living room with marble floor. MAID mops the floor; SON sits on a big sofa pretending to look at his phone but secretly watching her over it, smiling.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Villa kitchen. SON tells a joke with big hand gestures; MAID laughs shyly, covering her mouth with her hand.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Elegant villa dining room. MAID serves a tajine on the table; SON sitting at the table looks up at her and they exchange a long admiring glance, small hearts of tension, both a bit shy.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Sunny villa driveway with palm trees. SON leans proudly on a shiny black Mercedes car, jingling the keys. In the background MAID peeks at him from behind a window curtain, dreamy.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A small cozy bedroom in the villa at night, lamp light. MAID sits on the bed hugging her knees, worried and thinking, looking at the door.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Villa kitchen. SON hands MAID a pretty gift bag and a takeaway food box with a charming smile; MAID hesitates, surprised but happy.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Villa salon. In the foreground HAJJA and HAJJ sit on a Moroccan sofa calmly drinking mint tea, totally unaware. Behind them, in the hallway, SON secretly winks at MAID who holds a tray and hides a smile.
